field_principles.llm_invoked: bare bool false proving Exp5575 is a deterministic precheck and spends no live LLM inference.
field_principles.prior_trace_path: path to the recorded SGE trace used only for collapse diagnosis, not solve credit.
field_principles.collapse_definition: fixed thresholds declared before evaluating the prior trace.
field_principles.collapse_detected_on_prior_trace: bare bool true only when the fixed repeated-strategy, pairwise-distance, repeated-action, and null-outcome signals trip the collapse gate.
field_principles.diversity_metrics_before_after: records strategy/action diversity before and after forced anti-stagnation routing.
field_principles.forced_portfolio: bounded live-path-compatible strategy categories spanning observation, coordinate probe, action-type probe, mechanic falsification, and recovery/reset.
field_principles.taboo_policy: outcome-conditioned taboo set derived only from recently failed normalized strategies.
field_principles.e3_import_path: exact submitted path proving E3AgentPolicy reaches SGECandidateRouter through candidate_router.rank.
field_principles.live_path_reachable: bare bool proving the controller is reachable through the scored E3 candidate-router hook.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: must be false because precheck readiness cannot use oracle or hidden-source verifiers.
field_principles.win_check_used_for_ranking: must be false because strategy ranking cannot inspect win, level-completion, scorecard, or source signals.
field_principles.registry_precheck: structured evidence that registry depth was read and duplicate or exhausted targets were rejected before target selection.
field_principles.target_game: registry-safe game id selected for the next SGE live attempt.
field_principles.target_level: adjacent unreproduced frontier level selected after duplicate and exhaustion checks.
field_principles.prior_levels_reproduced: registry depth before the attempted target; target_level must be greater.
field_principles.action_budget: bounded action budget chosen before live inference.
field_principles.tests_run: exact test commands proving fake-completer behavior and full Python suite status.
field_principles.positive_control_passed: bare bool true only when fake-completer collapse activation and E3 reachability tests pass.
field_principles.solve_provenance: must equal live_agent_self_discovery because the follow-up live attempt must be the scored runtime own discovery path.
field_principles.target_unsolved: a target already reproduced at the requested level cannot receive duplicate solve credit.
field_principles.live_path_ready: live inference requires tested E3 reachability, a new mechanism, and no oracle leakage.
field_principles.honest_verdict: one-line verdict starting complete: or blocked: without claiming a solve.
